**Yes, one loss event was detected, but it is not yet corroborated.**

- **Detection:** The latest run (run-2, using Hansen GFC v1.13 data through 2025) found a tree-cover loss event of about 13.5 ha in 2025. That is roughly 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property. The JRC 2020 forest map shows forest on 98% of the event area, so the loss falls on land that was forest at the end of 2020.
